description: Sign-out revokes the presented refresh token without failing for an unknown token.

preconditions: Refresh token T1 is stored for account organizer@example.com.
cases.return: Completes without error; T1 is revoked, so no new access token can be issued with it (an access token already issued stays valid until expiry).

cases.log: Sign-out with no live refresh token; nothing to revoke.
preconditions: Token store has no live record of the token (already revoked, expired or never issued).
cases.return: Completes without error and without a failure result; sign-out is treated as successful.

cases.log: Sign-out with no live refresh token; nothing to revoke.
preconditions: No token store call is needed for a blank token.
cases.return: Completes without error; the token store is not called.

cases.log: Sign-out with no live refresh token; nothing to revoke.
preconditions: No token store call is needed for a whitespace token.
cases.return: Completes without error; the token store is not called.

preconditions: Account has two sessions with refresh tokens T1 and T2.
cases.return: Only T1 is revoked; T2 stays usable for the other session.
